content.short: Acurast provides acurast, Decentralized Serverless Cloud.
content.description: Acurast harnesses the collective power of mobile devices to deliver a decentralized, trustless cloud that emphasizes security and confidentiality while keeping compute costs low. By enabling anyone to contribute processing power with a simple QR scan, it opens a scalable, community-based infrastructure where participants can earn rewards for their idle devices. The approach combines distributed resources with privacy-centric design to create an alternative cloud layer that operates without a centralized single point of control.
